perturbation.seed: seed = (cell << 48) | (j << 32) | i with the cell index 0..39 of this table, j = 1..8 and the component index i = 0..n-1 (injective for cell, j < 2^16 and i < 2^32; asserted)
perturbation.draw: xi = the first output z of SplitMix64 started at state = seed (state += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15, then z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9, z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111eb, z ^ (z >> 31), wrapping), mapped linearly onto [-1, 1): xi = 2 ((z >> 11) * 2^-53) - 1
perturbation.start: y0_i * (1.0 + 1.0e-8 * xi) in f64 in this order of operations; a zero component stays zero; j = 0 is the unperturbed start (no draw); S and P1 of a pair start from the bitwise same state (the log records start_sha256)

K.frozen: there is no replayed stage system on which P1 exhausts the Krylov budget and S does not (subset), in any cell, along either trajectory
K.systems: every stage system of the unperturbed run of S and of the unperturbed run of P1 in every cell: the completed solves of every attempt and, for an attempt that failed before all eight solves completed, the system of the stage at which it failed (the rule of the V25 replay). The right-hand side is rebuilt from the driver's U form with the stage values of the attempt; the operator is I - h gamma J(t, y) with J the problem's JVP at (t, y)
K.kernels: each system is solved again from the zero start by the shipped kernel (solve_gmres_into_with_accounting, ResidualAccounting::DEFAULT, identity preconditioner, GmresCapacity::unbounded, GmresIntoOptions::default) and by the P1 kernel (StagedGmresWorkspace::solve_column_tested_into, first cycle = restart 40, ResidualAccounting::DEFAULT), both with GmresConfig {restart 40, max_arnoldi 200, rtol 1e-10, atol raw_absolute_residual_budget(1e-14, gamma)}, the configuration the driver hands its kernel
K.classification: Replay::of (mf_confirm_measure.rs, unchanged): an iterate -> its column count; Err(LinearSolve(text)) with text starting 'GMRES exhausted' -> budget (-1); any other error -> other (-2)
K.counted: a K-system is a per-system line 'Y' whose P1 code is -1 and whose shipped code is not -1. K PASS iff there is no K-system in the 80 replay runs; FAIL iff there is one. Every system on which the two kernels differ in their class (solved, budget, other) is listed in RESULTS.json with cell, trajectory, attempt, stage, h and both codes
K.coverage: decides NOT_DECIDABLE (not FAIL) when no K-system is found: every replay run present with exit code 0 and its V28_SHADOW_JSON; the per-system log present with the raw and gz sha256 of the footer; the lines recounted by the parser equal the summary (attempts, systems, per-kernel solved, budget, other, p1_budget_shipped_not); rebuild_failures 0; the driver's own kernel reproduces the driver on every replayed system (replay_differs_from_driver 0: same column count for a completed solve, budget for a budget failure, other for any other failure); the driver ran to t1 (completed); no write error

V.frozen: 0 violations of the stage threshold by a completed P1 solve in the replay
V.counted: every line 'Y' with a P1 code >= 0: violation iff the residual ||rhs - (U - h gamma J U)||_2 of the returned iterate, formed by the target with its own JVP and buffers (the formula of ProtectedAudit of V17), is not finite or exceeds the stage threshold max(gamma 1e-14 rounded down, 1e-10 ||rhs||_2) formed by the target; recounted by the parser from the bits in the per-system logs. Also counted as violations: the P1 kernel's reported residual not finite or above the same threshold. Reported, not a violation: a P1 kernel threshold whose bits differ from the target's threshold
V.verdict: PASS iff 0 violations over the 80 replay runs and the coverage of K holds; FAIL iff any violation (frozen verdict KILL); NOT_DECIDABLE iff no violation and the coverage fails

T.frozen: over the 320 pairs, d = exhausting solves of P1 minus those of S; with W = number of pairs with d > 0 and n = number of pairs with d != 0, the one-sided exact binomial probability P(X >= W), X ~ Bin(n, 1/2), is at least 0.05 (if n = 0, T holds)
T.pairs: cell index 0..39 x j = 1..8; the S run and the P1 run of a pair (ensemble logs)
T.d: policy_statistics.budget_exhausted_solves of the P1 run minus that of the S run (the driver's count, rodas5p_matrix_free_fast.rs:1747-1756, as in rule B of V24 and V25); a run that ends with an error enters with the statistics it reports
T.probability: p = sum_{k=W..n} C(n, k) / 2^n in exact rational arithmetic (fractions.Fraction); PASS iff p >= 1/20; n = 0: PASS
T.coverage: NOT_DECIDABLE iff a run of a pair is missing, was stopped by the time limit, or has no policy_statistics, or the two runs of a pair do not start from the same state (start_sha256) or a perturbed start equals the unperturbed start

report_without_rule.totals: budget-exhausting solves per family and arm: over the ensemble (j = 1..8), over the unperturbed driver runs of the replay, and over the reproduction runs (j = 0)
report_without_rule.attempts_ratio_per_pair: attempts(P1) / attempts(S) of the two runs of a pair (attempts of the result = accepted + rejected)
report_without_rule.error_ratio_per_pair: E(P1) / E(S) with E = max_i |y_i(t1) - ref_i| / (1 + |ref_i|) (V17 metric) against the unperturbed reference of the family (reference_for_the_error_report of the cell table); the reference is not corrected for the perturbation of the start (relative 1e-8), which is stated next to the numbers
report_without_rule.replay: per cell and trajectory: systems, per-kernel solved / budget / other, columns of the solved systems, largest residual over threshold of each kernel

verdict_computation.KEEP: V PASS and K or T FAIL
verdict_computation.NOT_DECIDABLE: otherwise (no FAIL that decides, at least one NOT_DECIDABLE): no default changes, the obstacle is reported (status partial)
